title: Balanced brackets
description:
Write `public static class Brackets` with `public static bool IsBalanced(string text)` using a `Stack<char>`. The brackets `()`, `[]` and `{}` must be properly nested and closed; every other character is ignored.

```csharp
Brackets.IsBalanced("f(a[1], {b: 2})");   // true
Brackets.IsBalanced("(]");                // false
Brackets.IsBalanced("((");                // false
```
hints: Push every opening bracket. On a closing bracket, pop and check that it closes the bracket you popped; an empty stack at that moment means the text is unbalanced.
At the end, anything still on the stack was never closed.
